compositionIssues.detail: [composition/viewport-height] Preserve every node, relationship, and label. This 1080x780 canvas (ratio 1.38) declares no intrinsic-height fit and is below the 1.55 wide ratio, so the desktop Reader can neither narrow it nor accept vertical scroll: it renders 972px tall at the full 1346px width and the page reaches 1098px before cards against 900px, a certain visual-check failure. Either compact vertical spacing so meta.viewBox height is at most 696 at this width, or spread content sideways so the width is at least 1209 at this height; for architecture and readable-v2 workflow, omitting meta.viewBox lets the renderer size the canvas and declare the fit.
